description: List the US states that have exotic car rental listings, or the cities of one state, with the number of cars and companies and the lowest published daily rate in each. Use this when someone asks where they can rent exotic cars, which cities have the most supercars, or when you are unsure how the catalog spells a city before calling search_vehicles. Without state: states only. With an unknown state: an empty list with did_you_mean. Places without a page of their own link the state page.

state.description: a state to list its cities; omit to list the states

name: browse_locations

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change
